description: Unit test class for testing link rendering in Markdown content within a Confluence documentation format of a static site generator project.

classes.name: LinkRendererTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class designed to validate the rendering of Markdown links to HTML in a Confluence content type implementation.

methods.name: providerRenderLink
methods.description: Provides test data for testing various link rendering scenarios, including external URLs, internal page links, links with anchors, mailto links, and links with embedded nodes.

methods.name: testRenderLink
methods.description: Test method utilizing data from providerRenderLink to verify that Markdown links are correctly converted into HTML with appropriate structures and attributes.
